activityEmpty: Working out the Q-range for that configuration

function.description: Compute the Q-range (QMin/QMax), wavelength range, TOF range and beam diameter for a named EQ-SANS configuration. Use list_qrange_configs first if unsure of the exact name. QMin is idealised from the beamstop size alone; QMinPractical is the more realistic estimate — prefer it when asked what Q is actually achievable, and say it is an estimate.
function.name: qrange_lookup

config_name.description: Configuration name, e.g. 'conf_4000mm_2p5A_60Hz'. A label like '4m 2.5a' also works.

function.description: List every EQ-SANS configuration name available to qrange_lookup and to the script builders' `configs` argument.
function.name: list_qrange_configs

function.description: Generate a complete EQ-SANS scan script for a set of samples across one or more configurations: imports, setipts, then a transmission block and a scattering block per configuration. The empty-beam transmission run is added automatically. Deterministic — always use this instead of writing the script by hand.
function.name: build_sample_script

configs.description: Configurations to measure — an exact name ('conf_4000mm_2p5A_60Hz') or a plain label ('4m 2.5a', '9m 15a 30hz'). Pass through what the user said.

configs_without_empty_beam.description: Subset of `configs` whose empty beam was ALREADY measured earlier in this experiment. Leave empty for a first script — every configuration needs its own.

ipts.description: IPTS number. Use 99999 if the user hasn't given one.

samples.description: Samples to measure at each configuration.

items.description: Sample ITEM number (0 if none assigned).

pos.description: Position/slot in the rack. -1 for a non-standard environment.

trans.description: Measure transmission. Defaults to true; only set false for a deliberate scattering-only repeat.

scatt_limit.description: Proton charge for scattering runs. Default 1.0.

trans_limit.description: Proton charge for transmission runs. Default 0.15.

function.description: Generate an EQ-SANS temperature-series script: a loop over temperatures that sets the controllers, waits for equilibration, then measures. Includes the >=80C polysci chiller guard. Deterministic — always use this instead of writing the script by hand.
function.name: build_temperature_script

controls.description: Controllers to set. Default: both peltier blocks.

ipts.description: IPTS number; omit if already set.

items.description: Sample ITEM number (0 if none assigned).

pos.description: Position/slot in the rack. -1 for a non-standard environment.

trans.description: Measure transmission. Defaults to true; only set false for a deliberate scattering-only repeat.

trans_temps.description: Temperatures at which to also measure transmission. Default none — transmission is normally measured once, at the initial temperature.
